description:
In Episode 222 we discuss how Donald Trump in his first 100 days as president of the USA has implemented many of the proposals in the Project 2025 agenda through executive orders and appointments in his cabinet, even though he distanced himself from it in the past.  With the "White House Faith Office" that he created, and now the "Religious Liberty Commission", Church and state is certainly joined together. Is this the final healing the wound for the beast of Revelation 13?
